question: Will the 12-month change in U.S. core CPI (CPI-U less food and energy, seasonally adjusted; computed from the index) for May 2024 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2024-05-15) be below 3.70%?

rule.threshold_basis: a round number near the lower quartile of historical moves over the same distance

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
